packet.title: Constructor lowering (implementation) — Early
packet.summary: Adds the construct lowering part for direct and computed constructors, enclosed expressions, boundary-space, name expressions and the in-scope namespaces of constructed elements.

body.p: (): part construct, tests/xquery_lower_construct_test.c (golden IR, values, static errors, allocation-failure loops). The 13 sets pass 932 of 1,165 (scratch harness, 59 not run); all but 7 of the run queries without a prolog pass (none of the 7 is lowering's), so the 90% bar waits for 3.10 to let prologs through (167 queries). After , . Owns src/xquery_lower_construct.c, tests/xquery_lower_construct_test.c. Direct and computed element, attribute, namespace, text, comment, PI and document constructors; enclosed expressions; boundary-space; in-scope namespaces of constructed elements (XQST0085); name expressions. Done when prod-DirElemConstructor, prod-DirElemContent, prod-DirElemContent.namespace, prod-DirElemContent.whitespace, prod-DirAttributeList, prod-CompElemConstructor, prod-CompAttrConstructor and the other prod-Comp*Constructor sets ≥ 90%. Spec: XQuery 4.0 "Direct Element Constructors", "Computed Constructors".
